typical_deviations: Consolidated reporting modeled as a single component; tax master-data interface missing.
Data-table-centred view; Association used for all cross-layer relationships.
Consolidated reporting split into 5 microservices and 11 CRUD pop-up pages; business role linked directly to a database.
Bank-enterprise direct-connection channel modeled as a business service instead of an application interface; fabricated automatic freezing link between finance and legal.
A single procurement reconciliation page promoted to a level-1 business capability; supplier master data conflicts with the finance domain's customer/supplier master data.
E-tendering system split into 4 components along its database tables; Composition used instead of Realization.
All self-built material procurement systems of second-tier subsidiaries marked as independently retained, contrary to the group-wide "one architecture" principle.
Fabricated real-time link between the procurement platform and a foreign tax system (LLM association); approval buttons modeled as separate application services.
Clear boundary between bid management and contract archiving, but the customer/supplier master-data interface drawn as a one-way push from the sales system to the master-data system.
Fairly complete four-layer structure; overlaps with S2-V09 in core components but the call direction of the revenue-recognition interface is reversed.
CRM split into 7 technical components along microservice gateway routes; value-stream step linked directly to the underlying message queue.
Each countersigning step of the contract approval flow drawn as a separate application component; fabricated link by which the legal system automatically deducts project funds.
Contract master data includes subcontract and labour-contract entities, but its key and ownership definition contradict the procurement domain's contract ledger.
Flow and Serving relationships mixed; self-built legal systems of second-tier subsidiaries marked as retained.
Complete treasury payment and funds-planning chain, but the treasury system split into 3 subsystems, inconsistent with the single treasury component in the finance domain.
Focus on fund flows and account master data; similarity with S2-V15 is 47.2% (GED = 57, total size 56 + 52 = 108).
